verses.text: God, prove that I am innocent. Defend my cause against an ungodly nation. Rescue me from liars and evil people.
You are God, my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go around crying because my enemy is crushing me?
Send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to the place where you live.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise you with the harp, God, my God.
Why are you so sad, my soul? Why are you so upset inside me? Put your hope in God! I will praise him again, my saviour, my helper, and my God.
